camel_example: aliyun ons OnsDLQMessagePageQueryByGroupId --region cn-hangzhou --TaskId 0BC1310300002A9F000021E4D7A48346 --EndTime 1570809600000 --PageSize 5 --CurrentPage 2 --InstanceId MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --BeginTime 1570723200000 --GroupId GID_test_group_id
description_en: Queries dead-letter messages by page for a specified Group ID and time range
description_zh: 通过传入Group ID和时间段，分页查询指定时间段内该Group ID内存在的所有死信消息
kebab_example: aliyun ons ons-dlq-message-page-query-by-group-id --group-id GID_test_group_id --begin-time 1570723200000 --end-time 1570809600000 --task-id 0BC1310300002A9F000021E4D7A48346 --current-page 2 --page-size 5 --instance-id MQ_INST_111111111111_DOxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: OnsDLQMessagePageQueryByGroupId

parameters.help_en: The ID of the consumer group to query
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en:
The start of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
If you specify `TaskId` to retrieve more pages, this parameter is ignored. The start time from the first query is used
parameters.help_zh:
查询范围的起始时间戳，单位：毫秒。
通过TaskId进行后续取消息时，该参数设置的值不生效，默认以第一次查询时输入的起始时间为准
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
If you specify `TaskId` to retrieve more pages, this parameter is ignored. The end time from the first query is used
parameters.help_zh:
查询范围的终止时间戳，单位：毫秒。
通过TaskId进行后续取消息时，该参数设置的值不生效，默认以第一次查询时输入的终止时间为准
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the query task. Omit this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, use the task ID returned by the previous query
parameters.help_zh: 查询任务的ID，首次查询不需要输入，后续取消息必须传入，根据前一次的返回结果取出该字段
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Pages start from 1. The value can be up to 50 and must not exceed the total number of pages
parameters.help_zh: 当前取第几页消息，从1开始递增，最大值为50，取消息时不可超过最大页数
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The number of messages to return on each page. Default value: 20. Minimum value: 5. Maximum value: 50.
If you specify `TaskId` to retrieve more pages, this parameter is ignored. The page size from the first query is used
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询，每页最多显示的消息数量，默认显示20条，最小5条，最多50条。
通过TaskId进行后续取消息时，该参数设置的值不生效，默认以第一次查询时输入的每页消息数量为准
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance that contains the message
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的消息所对应的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

MaxPageCount.description_en: The total number of pages available

OnsRestMessageDo.description_en: The list of messages on the current page. The data type is the same as the data type of the response to the [OnsDLQMessageGetById]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112667.html） operation
OnsRestMessageDo.description_zh: 当前页的消息集合，该类型与[OnsDLQMessageGetById]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112667.html）的返回结果一致

BodyCRC.description_en: The cyclic redundancy check (CRC) value of the message body

BornHost.description_en: The producer that generated the message
BornHost.description_zh: 生成该消息的生产者实例

BornTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp for when the message was produced

Name.description_en:
The message property. Valid values:

TRACE_ON: Indicates whether a message trace exists.

KEYS: The key of the message.

TAGS: The tag of the message.

INSTANCE_ID: The ID of the instance that contains the message.

For more information, see [Terms]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29533.html）
Name.description_zh:
消息属性。取值说明如下：
TRACE_ON：是否有消息轨迹。
KEYS：消息的Key属性。
TAGS：消息的Tag属性。
INSTANCE_ID：消息所在的实例的ID。

更多概念信息，请参见[名词解释]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29533.html）

Value.description_en: The value of the message property

ReconsumeTimes.description_en: The number of times the message has been reconsumed

StoreHost.description_en: The server that stores the message
StoreHost.description_zh: 存储该消息的服务器实例

StoreTimestamp.description_en: The UNIX timestamp for when the message was stored on the server
StoreTimestamp.description_zh: 消息被服务端存储的时间戳

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the query task. This ID is returned on the first query. Use this ID to retrieve subsequent pages
TaskId.description_zh: 第一次新建查询时，返回的查询任务ID，用于后续取消息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Each request has a unique ID. Use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
